card.name: Inside pneumonia and similar medical words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of long medical words, mostly "um" in Pne|um|onia, Pne|um|onitis and Pne|um|ocystis. It also fires on pieces such as "cos" in glycosuria and "ill" in penicillamine.

modes.label: Pneumo- words
modes.description: The "um" piece after "Pne" in pneumonia, pneumonitis and Pneumocystis.
